step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture was extracted by first identifying distinct visual components on the whiteboard diagram. Each icon or labeled box was mapped to its corresponding AWS service or external actor from the allowed list. Floating text like 'PCI', 'PROD EDW', and 'TOKEN' were used to enrich the 'notes' for relevant nodes but were not created as separate nodes, adhering to the strict visual-first rule. Two distinct accounts, 'PCI account' and 'Prod account', were inferred from the diagram's vertical dashed lines and transcript and noted within the relevant nodes. Edges were drawn strictly based on visible arrows on the diagram, ensuring no speculative return paths or implicit connections were created. The logical flow of data from on-premises sources through ingestion, processing, and consumption was used to assign `flow_id` and `seq` values.

graph.name: Discover Financial Services Cloud Data Platform
graph.notes: Architecture for Discover Financial Services' cloud data platform, separating PCI-compliant data processing in a dedicated PCI account from general analytics and machine learning in a production account. Handles petabyte-scale data.

nodes.name: On-Premises
nodes.notes: Various data sources on-premises, running data ingestion pipelines.

nodes.name: SFTP
nodes.notes: AWS Transfer for SFTP used for ingesting external data into S3.

nodes.name: PrivateLink
nodes.notes: AWS PrivateLink used for ingesting on-premises data to the PCI account's landing S3 bucket.

nodes.name: S3 Landing Bucket
nodes.notes: S3 landing bucket in the PCI account. Receives raw PCI data, with S3 lifecycle policies and triggers enabled. This is where the initial ingested data lands. Also maintains an archive bucket for audit purposes.

nodes.name: SNS Topic
nodes.notes: SNS topic subscribed by security services in EC2, triggered by S3 object creation in the landing bucket.

nodes.name: Security Services
nodes.notes: EC2 instances in the PCI account running security services for data tokenization, file format conversion, and data curation. PCI scope is limited to this account.

nodes.name: S3 Curated Data
nodes.notes: S3 bucket in the production account. Stores curated and tokenized data from the PCI account. Serves as a petabyte-scale data warehouse (EDW) for analytics and machine learning. This data is synced to the EDW for general purpose consumption.

nodes.name: Analytics & ML Services
nodes.notes: EC2 instances and other container platforms in the production account for general purpose analytics and machine learning consumption.

edges.notes: On-premises data ingestion pipeline uses PrivateLink.
Data ingested via PrivateLink to the S3 landing bucket in the PCI account.
External data ingests to on-premises then uses SFTP.
SFTP ingests data into the S3 landing bucket in the PCI account.
S3 landing bucket triggers an SNS topic upon data arrival.
SNS notifies EC2 security services for consumption and processing.
Curated and tokenized data from PCI EC2 services is ingested into the production S3 bucket.
Analytics and machine learning services consume curated data from the production S3 bucket.
